mentions.name: Akariq
mentions.description: This eSIM service provides mobile data plans covering 185+ countries and regions worldwide, positioned 2-3x cheaper than big brands in the same space. It emphasizes local data routing, keeping traffic in the user's country or region (e.g., not routing US or EU traffic through Hong Kong), along with low latency, plan transparency, and better fair-use policies.
mentions.problem: Big-brand eSIM plans are more expensive and often route user traffic out of the user's country or region (e.g., US/EU traffic through Hong Kong).
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building Akariq which provides data eSIM data plans to 185+ countries and regions across the world. I am 2-3x cheaper than big brands in the same space. I also prefer local data routing i.e. I don't route traffic from US or EU to Hong Kong, they stay in your country / region.
